name: Rice Lemon Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: quarter of a pound of butter
ingredients.originalText: one quarter of a pound of butter

ingredients.name: the grated peel with the juice of two lemons
ingredients.originalText: the grated peel with the juice of two lemons

ingredients.name: the yolks and beaten whites of four eggs
ingredients.originalText: the yolks and beaten whites of four eggs

instructions.text: Put on to boil one quart of milk
When it simmers stir in four tablespoonfuls of rice flour that has been moistened in a little milk
Let it come to a boil and remove from the fire
Add one quarter of a pound of butter
When cool, add the grated peel with the juice of two lemons and the yolks and beaten whites of four eggs
Add one wine-glassful of wine in the last thing

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put on to boil one quart of milk
2. When it simmers stir in four tablespoonfuls of rice flour that has been moistened in a little milk
3. Let it come to a boil and remove from the fire
4. Add one quarter of a pound of butter
5. When cool, add the grated peel with the juice of two lemons and the yolks and beaten whites of four eggs
6. Sweeten to taste
7. Add one wine-glassful of wine in the last thing
